definitions.explanation: A chemical product that removes unwanted hair by dissolving the protein structure of hair. Applied to skin, left for several minutes, then wiped or rinsed away. Sold at pharmacies and convenience stores.

examples.japanese: {脱毛剤|だつもうざい}を{使|つか}って{足|あし}の{毛|け}を{処理|しょり}した。
examples.english: I removed leg hair using a hair removal cream.

examples.japanese: {脱毛剤|だつもうざい}は{肌|はだ}が{弱|よわ}い{人|ひと}はパッチテストをしてから{使|つか}ってください。
examples.english: People with sensitive skin should do a patch test before using hair removal cream.

examples.japanese: {脱毛剤|だつもうざい}は{薬局|やっきょく}やドラッグストアで{購入|こうにゅう}できる。
examples.english: Hair removal cream can be purchased at pharmacies and drugstores.

notes:
Compound of {脱毛|だつもう} (hair removal) + {剤|ざい} (agent; compound). The base word {脱毛|だつもう} covers all forms of hair removal.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {脱毛剤|だつもうざい}を{塗|ぬ}る: to apply hair removal cream
- {脱毛剤|だつもうざい}で{処理|しょり}する: to treat with depilatory

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {除毛剤|じょもうざい}: depilatory — similar term, often used interchangeably
- {脱毛|だつもう}: hair removal — the general term covering all methods (laser, wax, cream)
- カミソリ: razor — for shaving, not chemical removal
